_comment: Provisional tuning. GDD 12 leaves the tick-to-year mapping open; see doc/DECISIONS.md D5.
_body_comment: The game hour is compressed (DECISIONS.md D5), so walk_tiles_per_hour is tuned against work and needs rather than real-world walking: 55 metres/hour keeps distance costly without letting travel consume the whole day.
_climate_comment: A river valley in the Fertile Crescent. Winter used to average one degree against a hypothermia line of five, so the cold ran the whole season with no let-up and health could never recover: see DECISIONS.md D82.
_farming_comment: Water led onto poor soil improves the ground itself, and the improvement stays: half a point of fertility a day, so a season of watering turns desert into something worth sowing. See DECISIONS.md D90.
